purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: A first-party Mykolaiv City Council urban-cadastre geoportal was fetched successfully and its HTML exposed a named municipal land-parcel register. The linked register returned HTTP 404. Official Ukrainian NSDI documentation describes WFS and coordinate parcel routes, but bounded anonymous requests to the guessed public API base returned HTTP 404. No safe parcel ID, geometry, schema response, owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax, or account field was requested or retained.
registryAssessment: Local registry/map custody is evidenced by the official Mykolaiv City Council urban-cadastre geoportal and its named land-parcel register link. Availability of the actual parcel dataset and city coverage remain unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official municipal geoportal; landing page returned 200 and exposed the land-parcel register link.
Official city page describing the urban-cadastre GIS and its intended spatial-information functions.
Official NSDI WFS documentation describing a parcels layer, EPSG:4326 and bbox/count/propertyName parameters; documentation example only, not a verified city response.
Official regional StateGeoCadastre explanation of national cadastral-map and parcel-registration functions.
